text:
Ava (PM): quick sync — i rescored the Q2 sheet after the customer meeting. three asks moved above the infra-ish bets. need opinions on sequencing + launch gates.
Rohan (Eng): can you paste the new numbers?
Ava (PM): sure, tiny snippet below — i focused on reach + impact changes based on customer ARR and urgency.
```
Feature A: R=8 I=7 C=3 E=5 => RICE=280
Feature B: R=5 I=9 C=2 E=4 => RICE=225
Feature C (infra): R=3 I=6 C=1 E=9 => RICE=162
```
Marta (Data): interesting — Feature B jumps because that one customer is high ARR + will reduce churn if we deliver. i adjusted impact to 9 after reweighting churn->revenue.
Chen (Design): Feature A has a lot of UX unknowns. if we cut scope to an MVP we could parallelize with Feature B.
Rohan (Eng): agree on parallel work, but infra (C) has cross-team risk. re: cost/effort we should consider sequencing by dependency not just RICE.
Sam (Sales): from GTM, Feature B unlocks a pilot with a Fortune 200 client — they want M1 timeframe. that could be >$200k ARR in year 1.
Liam (VP Product): two asks: 1) we need concrete launch gates per feature (SLOs, cost delta, key metric), 2) run a sensitivity check on the RICE inputs (small changes to reach/impact can flip order).
Ava (PM): proposal: keep Feature B as top priority for Q2 pilot, ship Feature A as scoped MVP in parallel, defer deep infra (C) to Q3 but allocate a small spike for compatibility. launch gates: p95 latency <350ms, customer NPS delta >= +6 in pilot, cost increase <=15% for that route.
Rohan (Eng): ok for spike. for the MVP of A, we can drop noncritical flows to hit E=5 estimate.
Marta (Data): i'll run a sensitivity matrix and post a short table by EOD — how volatile is ordering if reach changes +/-20%?
Chen (Design): i'll draft MVP flows and a checklist for the NPS target.
Sam (Sales): i'll confirm pilot commitment and timeline from the customer (will update by tomorrow).
DeployBot: scheduled a canary window for feature-branch to staging at 2024-05-15T03:00Z :white_check_mark:
Liam (VP Product): decision for now: prioritize B (pilot), A-MVP in parallel with trimmed scope, C -> Q3 spike + revisit. record decisions in the sheet and add launch-gates section. thanks all. :thumbsup:
